name: settings-mcp
label: Settings
description: Finds a setting of the platform by words. It says where the setting lives, what it does and who changes it. For a setting the chat can show, it draws a card to change it in. It also draws a card with buttons, and a live list of tasks, triggers, notifications, machines or MCP servers. Everyone in the chat sees a card with their own sign-in. It never reads a value and never writes one. A card's button acts with the role of whoever presses it.
